compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 7f406df621ffc97beb36c31c62368aaf2c21f08d
* **Context Scope:** plugins/dso/scripts/skip-review-check.sh, plugins/dso/hooks/compute-diff-hash.sh, plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-allowlist.conf, plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The DSO review gate is intended to cover LLM-instruction artifacts (skills, prompts, agents, CLAUDE.md, hooks) but EXEMPT non-LLM-instruction documents from full code review. The set of non-reviewable document directories should be configurable per host project via .claude/dso-config.conf so a consuming project whose prose docs live outside the shipped docs/** exemption can declare them without editing plugin-shipped files.

#### Actual Behavior

The non-reviewable file classification is hardcoded in the plugin-shipped review-gate-allowlist.conf (consumed by skip-review-check.sh and compute-diff-hash.sh). It exempts docs/**, .claude/docs/**, .claude/session-logs/**, .claude/artifacts/** but provides NO dso-config.conf key for a host project to add its own non-LLM-instruction doc directories. A host whose docs live elsewhere (documentation/, adr/, wiki/) gets the full review process on minor Markdown edits. The only override seams are ALLOWLIST_OVERRIDE / CONF_OVERRIDE env vars, which exist for TEST ISOLATION. A host project worked around this by abusing those env vars and adding a blanket *.md exemption -- unsafe because skills/agents/prompts ARE markdown and would be silently exempted from the review meant to cover them.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

Reported by a host project running an older released DSO. Determine whether current DSO addresses configurability (it exempts docs/** but exposes no config key).

comments.body: Investigation complete (BASIC). ROOT_CAUSE: no review.non_reviewable_doc_dirs config key exists; non-reviewable classification is a static plugin-shipped allowlist with the only host override being the test-isolation env vars ALLOWLIST_OVERRIDE/CONF_OVERRIDE. Confirmed: (H1) no config key exists; (H2) docs outside docs/** -> exit 1 (full review); (H3) skills/ force-reviewed in skip-review-check.sh (case block runs before _matches_allowlist). KEY SAFETY FINDING: compute-diff-hash.sh has NO force-review guard (unlike skip-review-check.sh), so a misconfigured key including an LLM-instruction dir would silently drop it from the review hash -> hash-integrity hole. docs/** exemption present since the file's creation (966a7a5dc3); current DSO does NOT expose host-configurable doc dirs. Insertion points: skip-review-check.sh after line 74 (append to _ALLOWLIST_PATTERNS, before classification loop so force-review case still wins); compute-diff-hash.sh after line 171 (append to EXCLUDE_PATHSPECS). Fix complexity: MODERATE (single subsystem). Modifies safeguard files -> user approval required.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Fix implemented + verified GREEN. testing_mode=RED (new config-key path). Changes: (1) config-paths.sh reads review.non_reviewable_doc_dirs into CFG_NON_REVIEWABLE_DOC_DIRS and adds dso_sanitized_doc_dirs() helper with DSO_PROTECTED_REVIEW_DIRS filter (skills/hooks/agents/prompts/docs/workflows/.claude.skills/.claude.hooks/.claude.hookify/CLAUDE.md); (2) skip-review-check.sh appends sanitized dirs to _ALLOWLIST_PATTERNS after snapshot patterns, before the loop (force-review case still wins); (3) compute-diff-hash.sh appends :!dir/** to EXCLUDE_PATHSPECS symmetrically (closes the hash-asymmetry); (4) CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents the key + safety; (5) allowlist conf comment redirects hosts to the config key. New behavioral test tests/scripts/test-review-gate-config-doc-dirs.sh: 14/14 pass. Regression: test-skip-review-check (22), test-config-paths (28), test-compute-diff-hash* (40), test-review-gate-allowlist (8), test-check-allowlist-correctness (6), test-behavioral-equivalence-allowlist (39) all PASS. shellcheck clean.
